steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB as the first product and set its quantity to 10.
Set the first product's delivery location as required by the case.
Add enough additional products to reach the stated company maximum of 69 line items.
Attempt to add one product beyond the company maximum.
